thread:
claire: Hey team — noticed a surge of 404s for fragment links after the mkdocs -> docusaurus migration. Most reports point at /guides/installer and /guides/cluster.
devin: Any concrete examples?
claire: Support ticket 1242 shows /guides/installer#quickstart jumping to top. Also some old blog posts link to /guides/cluster#autoscaling and land at the top.
docs-bot: nightly-linkcheck: build 4410 found 8 broken fragments. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4410/linkcheck
henry: I pulled the generated HTML. A handful of headings were wrapped in our MDX admonition component in migration which changed slugs. Also a conversion bug left some headings indented so they became code blocks -> no slug at all.
alex: So we need two fixes: (A) fix content (unindent and add explicit ids) for headings that got swallowed; (B) produce compatibility redirects.json for external links that rely on old implicit slugs.
devin: For (A) I can run a quick grep to find indented headings: `rg "^\\s{4,}#{1,6} " docs | sed -n '1,200p'` and patch the installer and cluster guides.
claire: Please include explicit IDs on any headings we expect external links to use, e.g., `## Quickstart {#quickstart}`. That makes slugs stable.
henry: For (B) I'll prototype a slug-compat generator. Plan: scan git for previous heading lines, compute old slugs (mkdocs-style), diff against current slugs, and emit a redirects.json consumable by Docusaurus redirects plugin. Prototype link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1501 (draft).
devin: I'll open a small PR with manual fixes for installer/cluster and a note: "explicit heading ids + unindent to restore fragments".
docs-bot: CI: please note linkcheck will re-run after PR merge — nightly at 02:00 UTC.
alex: Add a lightweight integration test in `.github/workflows/linkcheck.yml` that asserts a short list of known anchors exist post-merge (quickstart, service-accounts, autoscaling). Prevents regressions.
henry: One caveat: some old slugs contained punctuation that our slugifier normalized differently. Slugmap needs a normalization step (strip punctuation, unicode fold). I'll add that to the proto.
claire: Good. Let's do this sequence: devin PR (content fixes) -> henry PR (slugmap + redirects) -> alex PR (linkcheck test). I'll run a local linkcheck before merging.
devin: Targeting PR today.
henry: Will turn draft into PR tomorrow and include a sample redirects.json.
docs-bot: Reminder: if you push fixes before redirects are in place, consider setting `onBrokenLinks: 'warn'` temporarily to avoid blocking deploys.
claire: Thanks all. Ping here when PRs are up and include the CI linkcheck artifact so I can review.
